pull_request.title: Qualify Rust 1.99.1 for development and CI
pull_request.body:
The development selector, explicit CI installation and setup documentation still use Rust 1.99.0. Select the official 1.99.1 patch release consistently for local development and the existing Linux/macOS CI matrix; the package's Rust 1.91 minimum and dependency lock remain unchanged.

The official stable manifest was checked during this pass: Rust 1.99.1, dated 2026-10-15. See [the release announcement](https://blog.rust-lang.org/2026/10/15/Rust-1.99.1/). Pending notes select compatible 0.5.5; package versions and release refs are unchanged.

Focused Linux validation on 1.99.1: formatter check, strict package Clippy across all targets, two reservation tests, three retained-region tests, ten Rustdoc examples, Wasm compilation, documentation links and diff checks. The existing hosted CI runs the complete repository gate on ubuntu-24.04 and macos-15; its results must pass before merge. No new behavioral tests are needed for a compiler-selector update. Full local release validation was not run.

Closes #14.

issue.body:
The 2026-10-18 read-only maintenance observation found development Rust 1.99.0 in rust-toolchain.toml at 249da24992da229464b809d44ffed7f5ab8d4bae. The official stable channel manifest currently identifies Rust **1.99.1**, dated **2026-10-15**.

Source: https://static.rust-lang.org/dist/channel-rust-stable.toml and [the official release announcement](https://blog.rust-lang.org/2026/10/15/Rust-1.99.1/). The patch fixes x86-64 FFI bool return handling, a direct-invocation macOS rust-lld library lookup problem and missing wcslen fallback symbols. This is an available-update finding; this pass did not demonstrate a repository regression under the old compiler.

Please select and qualify 1.99.1 in the owning development selector and explicit CI overrides, or document a concrete reason to retain 1.99.0. Keep package MSRV declarations independent and unchanged unless separately justified. Qualify the selected formatter/Clippy behavior, relevant native/Wasm packages and supported native hosts through the owner's focused commands/CI. Preserve active owner work, existing locks and unrelated pins; no source repair, installation or fresh compilation was performed by this pass.

Open issues and PRs plus all-state patch/topic search or complete repository issue/PR history were inspected before preparing this owning follow-up. Evidence is retained in maintenance run 20261018T070051Z.IcXxj4.
